title: Best AI Meeting Assistant 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: Compare Otter, Fireflies, Fathom, tl;dv, Avoma, Read.ai, and Granola on real 2026 pricing, transcription accuracy, and CRM workflow fit for your team.
short_desc: AI meeting assistants compared on 2026 pricing and accuracy.
tldr_pick: Fathom — best AI meeting assistant in 2026 for most people. Unlimited free recording and transcription for Zoom/Meet/Teams, no time caps, no credit card. If you run a sales team that needs CRM logging, switch to Fireflies at $10/user/mo. If you need multilingual accuracy above 95%, switch to Otter.
who_for: Anyone who sits in more than 3 meetings a week — founders, sales reps, recruiters, PMs, and consultants who want searchable transcripts and AI summaries.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reviews from zapier.com, brixi.ai, and meetingnotes.com, cross-referenced each vendor's official pricing page, and compared transcription accuracy (where published), pricing tiers, and integration depth. This is an editorial roundup, not a hands-on benchmark — every tool listed has a usable free tier so you can verify fit before committing.
key_takeaways: Fathom is the only major player with an unlimited free tier in 2026 — it is the default pick for individuals and small teams.
Published accuracy leaders in 2026: Otter (96% on English), Fireflies (94%), Fathom (90-92%).
Sales teams should default to Fireflies for native Salesforce/HubSpot CRM sync.
Multilingual teams should pick Otter Pro or tl;dv — Fathom is English-first.

faq.q: What is the best AI meeting assistant in 2026?
faq.a: For most people, Fathom is the best AI meeting assistant in 2026 — unlimited free recording and transcription across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams with no time caps. For sales teams that need CRM logging, Fireflies at $10/user/mo is the better pick. For top-tier English accuracy and multilingual support, Otter Pro is the leader.

faq.q: Is there a free AI meeting assistant?
faq.a: Yes — Fathom's free tier is the most generous in the category: unlimited recording, transcription, and AI summaries with no minute caps and no credit card required. Otter, Fireflies, tl;dv, and Read.ai also offer free tiers but with stricter limits (300-1,000 minutes/mo typically).

faq.q: How accurate is AI meeting transcription in 2026?
faq.a: Independent 2026 benchmarks put Otter Pro at the top with ~96% word accuracy on English, Fireflies at ~94%, and Fathom at ~90-92%. Accuracy drops 5-15 percentage points on multilingual content and on poor audio. All major tools handle Zoom/Meet/Teams well; phone calls and in-person recording are weaker across the board.

faq.q: What is the cheapest AI meeting assistant?
faq.a: Fathom is free for unlimited use, which makes it the cheapest by default. Among paid tiers, Fireflies starts at $10/user/mo and Notta starts at $8.99/mo for basic transcription. Below $8/user/mo, quality and integration depth drop sharply.

faq.q: Do AI meeting assistants work with Google Meet and Microsoft Teams?
faq.a: Yes — Fathom, Otter, Fireflies, and tl;dv all work with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams in 2026. Some tools (Notta, Krisp) also support Webex and dial-in calls. In-person recording requires the vendor's mobile app or a hardware solution like limitless pendant.
